head: 898083a710e97a03f43e54ac1c56cfc5bca04942
claim: @byokit/pi 0.1.1 is prepared for consumer installation: the packed tarball installs into a fresh app and its public entry imports and exports createPiKit and PiError. Runtime behavior beyond that is not claimed.

steps.start: main with the @byokit/pi kit merged (#907); package.json no longer private
steps: Install the tarball and its exact Pi peer into a fresh consumer app with an empty HOME
Import @byokit/pi from the installed copy and create a kit
Give the kit a bad state folder and read the refusal
steps.result: The installed @byokit/pi 0.1.1 imports from node_modules and exports createPiKit and PiError.

verdicts.seen: Read all six lines of the capture. It shows the packed tarball as version 0.1.1, imports ./node_modules/@byokit/pi/dist/index.js, reports exports PiError,createPiKit, and says createPiKit ok with kit members bot,close. That directly supports the stated installation and public-entry outcome; runtime behavior beyond this is not claimed.
